name: Attentive
tagline: Attentive is an AI-powered conversational marketing platform focused on personalised SMS and email for e-commerce and retail. Its AI sends the right message to the right subscriber at the optimal time based on purchase history and engagement patterns. Over 8,000 brands use it to drive significant revenue from text message marketing.
